title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — dedicated price
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — Apply dedicated tenancy multiplier to that region-adjusted primary rate for dedicated tenancy mode, and a multiplier of one for other tenancy modes.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted review — dedicated price?**

Apply dedicated tenancy multiplier to that region-adjusted primary rate for dedicated tenancy mode, and a multiplier of one for other tenancy modes.
